GST Rate Cuts Erode Due to Inflation, Congress Claims

The Congress party has stated that the benefits of Goods and Services Tax (GST) rate cuts have been diminished by rising inflation. While GST changes initially provided relief, the subsequent increase in prices has negated these gains, impacting consumers' wallets. This situation has led to concerns about the erosion of purchasing power.
